questions.q: In this dissected liver image, which labelled vessel carries nutrient-rich blood from the gastrointestinal tract to the liver?
questions.explain: The portal vein carries blood from the gastrointestinal tract and spleen to the liver for processing. The inferior vena cava receives hepatic venous blood, while the hepatic artery supplies oxygenated blood.

questions.q: The portal vein, hepatic artery and bile duct are grouped together at the porta hepatis. Which connective-tissue structure encloses these elements within the hepatoduodenal ligament?
questions.explain: The hepatoduodenal ligament is the free edge of the lesser omentum and encloses the portal triad: portal vein, proper hepatic artery and bile duct.
